placements.title: identity derived from content when none is supplied
placements.frame: How does the system generate identity from content when explicit identity is absent, and what fallback chain ensures it succeeds?
placements.why: The segment prescribes the pipeline's requirement to produce a slug from memory content when no explicit id is provided, using either the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback, and to commit the file successfully. This names a thematic subject — automatic identity generation from content with a fallback chain — that future envelopes can keep feeding with more cases of unsupplied-identity handling, fallback ordering, or slug-generation variants. No existing leaf or strata holds this; the grain test admits it as a subject, not a one-time fact.
